metric_evidence.design_coherence: Observed across all 34 captures. The neutral surfaces, blue active markers, restrained borders, provider icons, and dark theme form a coherent system. Remaining inconsistencies include 16px versus 32px mobile page gutters, different desktop header offsets, and refresh actions rendered as outlined buttons, filled buttons, or borderless text.
metric_evidence.typography: Page titles, section headings, and technical identifiers have distinguishable roles. Remaining defects include the mobile Usage legend breaking Requests into two fragments, quota filenames wrapping into four lines, and small chart annotations colliding. Config also exposes implementation-oriented helper copy about another page's style.
metric_evidence.cleanliness: Most desktop pages are calm and scannable, with useful separators and little decoration. Remaining clutter comes from nested Config containers, repeated plugin refresh controls, duplicated model counts on System, and dense Logs toolbar wrapping.
metric_evidence.visual_design: The practical neutral/blue identity suits developer operations. Dark-mode surfaces and primary-button inversion are coherent. Remaining craft issues include clipped provider status content, weak dark-mode chart grid visibility, and uneven mobile empty-state composition.
metric_evidence.ease_of_use: Visible search, filtering, credential status, and explicit OAuth actions support common operations. Remaining friction includes mobile Providers showing only the provider catalog in the viewport, Logs placing messages outside the visible horizontal area, and Quick Start presenting setup instructions without visible destination links.
metric_evidence.information_hierarchy: Desktop section titles and summary strips establish useful structure. Remaining issues include Quick Start giving the APIKEY.FUN panel precedence over general setup, mobile Providers placing unconfigured choices before resource details, and Usage spending substantial viewport space on unavailable daily-history panels before model details.
metric_evidence.spacing_alignment: Desktop tables, summary strips, and most form fields align well. Remaining defects include the Providers prefix/model overlap, status content cut off beside the action region, inconsistent page gutters, and mobile plugin empty-state text squeezed between its icon and Refresh button.
metric_evidence.navigation_wayfinding: The desktop sidebar has clear task groups and active-page treatment. Breadcrumbs and mobile page names preserve context. Remaining issues include OAuth editor breadcrumbs stopping at Auth Files, horizontally cut-off mobile Auth Files tabs without an explicit overflow cue, and the truncated mobile Management Center header.
metric_evidence.responsive_mobile: Login fits cleanly, summary strips become two-column grids, and Config replaces its section sidebar with a dropdown. Remaining material issues include the tall Providers catalog preceding details, Logs retaining a desktop-width presentation, tall credential cards, and verbose quota legends consuming most of the chart's initial viewport.
metric_evidence.accessibility_visible: Login shows a strong focus outline, fields generally have visible labels, and chart legends use numbered identifiers rather than color alone. Remaining concerns visible in the captures include very small chart labels, crowded provider action icons, approximately 30px-high mobile action buttons, and faint secondary chart information in dark mode. Contrast compliance and actual hit areas were not measured.
metric_evidence.data_visualization: Charts state units, time context, snapshot limitations, and projection assumptions. Remaining defects include overlapping numbered markers for coincident quota series, overlapping zero-value request markers, long mobile legend labels, and a poorly proportioned zero-activity chart that consumes considerable space. Missing dated Usage history is treated as fixture-limited coverage, not a production defect.
metric_evidence.interaction_affordance: Primary actions, switches, tabs, disclosure triangles, and search fields are generally recognizable. Remaining ambiguity includes generic New and Save/Update labels, icon-only provider actions, the icon-only mobile quota refresh action losing its bulk scope, and plain-text Quick Start steps that name destinations without visibly linking them.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed defect. The workspace prefix overlaps Models/Headers content. Active, Success, and Failure status chips are visibly cut off at the left edge of the Actions region.
top_fixes.user_impact: Operators cannot read a resource's full status or cleanly distinguish adjacent fields at the supplied desktop width.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Give status and actions explicit non-overlapping column space. Truncate long prefixes within their own cell. Reduce optional columns or use deliberate horizontal scrolling before cells collide.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed hierarchy problem. Configured and unconfigured provider lists occupy the entire viewport. The selected provider's resources are not visible.
top_fixes.user_impact: A mobile operator must pass a long catalog before inspecting or managing the currently selected provider.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Replace the stacked catalog with a compact provider selector on mobile. Place selected-provider resources immediately below it. Move unconfigured providers into an Add provider flow or collapsed group.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed defect. The visible log area is dominated by timestamps and level columns. Message text begins near the right edge and is cut off. Toolbar controls occupy roughly 300px before the first entry.
top_fixes.user_impact: Mobile operators cannot scan the diagnostic message without navigating a wide log surface.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Use mobile log rows with timestamp and level on a compact first line and a wrapping message below. Put secondary fields in a disclosure. Consolidate download, clear, and fullscreen actions into a secondary menu.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed rendering defect under the supplied data. Coincident quota series stack numbered point labels into an unreadable cluster. Dashboard success/failure markers also overlap at zero. Mobile quota legends wrap filenames into several lines.
top_fixes.user_impact: Operators cannot reliably map coincident points to accounts, and the mobile legend competes with the plot for space.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Aggregate coincident point annotations into one readable count or grouped label. Preserve account identity in a compact legend with short names and separately available full filenames. Use a compact no-activity presentation for an all-zero request series. Do not alter fixture values to conceal overlap.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed density and discoverability issues. A single credential card extends below the viewport. The tab row cuts off OAuth Model Aliases, and the provider row cuts off Gemini without an explicit continuation control.
top_fixes.user_impact: Operators see little of a six-credential inventory and cannot immediately identify all available sections or filters.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Use compact credential summaries with account, provider, state, quota, and actions first. Expand request and timestamp details on demand. Add an explicit overflow affordance or use mobile selectors for the tab and provider rows.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed hierarchy and affordance issue. The APIKEY.FUN empty configuration panel appears before the general setup sequence. Setup steps name Providers, OAuth, Config, and Usage destinations as plain text. The panel's primary action is labeled New.
top_fixes.user_impact: A first-time operator is given a prominent service-specific action before the general connection path, with no visible direct actions on that path.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Lead with the general setup sequence and explicit destination links. Place the service-specific integration below it. Replace New with a label that states what will be created.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed responsive composition defects. Requests breaks mid-word inside its legend. Plugin empty-state prose is compressed between an icon and a right-hand Refresh button. Usage's unavailable-history panels consume much of the initial viewport.
top_fixes.user_impact: Mobile reading becomes unnecessarily fragmented, and useful operational details receive less initial space.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Prevent ordinary legend words from breaking. Stack empty-state actions below the text on narrow screens. Present unavailable history as a compact status block while keeping its explanation available. Preserve the distinction between missing data and zero.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed content issue. The API-key helper references consistency with an API Key Management page's style. A highlighted BestProxy.com recommendation appears immediately below the Proxy URL field.
top_fixes.user_impact: Operators receive implementation commentary and a visually promoted external service while configuring infrastructure.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Replace implementation commentary with the purpose and handling of client API keys. Remove the external recommendation from the primary form hierarchy or place it in clearly optional contextual help.

top_fixes.screen: Cross-screen headers, forms, and mobile actions
top_fixes.evidence: Observed inconsistency. Providers, Quick Start, and OAuth editors use wider page gutters than Dashboard and Config. Refresh styling varies. Mobile buttons frequently appear about 30px high, and quota refresh drops its visible all-credentials scope.
top_fixes.user_impact: Repeated actions are less predictable, narrow-screen space is used inconsistently, and compact controls provide less visible touch area.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Standardize page-shell spacing and action tiers. Provide at least 44px mobile hit areas without enlarging all surrounding content. Retain meaningful action scope through a short label such as Refresh all.

strengths: The neutral/blue identity is appropriate for technical operations. Preserve it rather than adding decorative visual weight.
The desktop sidebar groups tasks meaningfully and makes the current section easy to locate.
Login is contained, labeled, and usable within both supplied viewport sizes. Its visible focus treatment is clear.
Config's mobile section dropdown is a useful adaptation rather than a compressed desktop sidebar.
Status summaries distinguish connected, enabled, serving, loaded, skipped, and unavailable states instead of presenting every absence as zero.
Charts explain projection and snapshot limitations. Numbered legends provide a useful non-color identification channel.
Dark mode preserves the overall component system and clear primary text.
Plugin trust warnings communicate concrete backend access consequences. Empty registry contents are not treated here as a product failure.
unverified: All 34 supplied screenshot images were inspected. Evidence is viewport-only, not full-page.
No files were edited. No browser state was changed. No captures were run.
Keyboard navigation, screen-reader semantics, focus order, focus trapping, and actual touch hit areas were not tested.
Hover states, tooltips, disclosure behavior, horizontal scrolling, mobile navigation drawers, and chart interaction were not exercised.
Save, reload, refresh, upload, deletion, OAuth completion, validation, confirmation, and recovery behavior were not tested.
No live backend was used. Account names, credentials, and metrics are synthetic fixtures.
Quota and plugin fixture coverage is partial. Missing quota values, empty registries, and unavailable daily history do not demonstrate production defects.
Only Dashboard, Providers, Quota, and Config have supplied dark-mode captures. Other dark-mode pages and mobile dark mode remain unverified.
Contrast ratios were not measured. Accessibility scores cover visible presentation only.
Mobbin was authentication-blocked. No Mobbin references were inspected.
Comparison with mature developer dashboards is professional visual judgment, not evidence from usability studies or measured task performance.

metric_evidence.design_coherence: Observed. Shared shell, hairline cards, black primary buttons, teal focus/active accent, and grouped sidebar repeat across all 14 pages in light and dark. Refresh is rendered four ways (outlined button on Dashboard, plain text on Usage, Reload text on Config, icon-only on mobile Quota), and off-system promo badges break the system (below).
metric_evidence.typography: Observed. Clear sans H1/section scale and appropriate mono for keys, versions, timestamps, and log lines. Counter-evidence: very small light-gray metadata and chart hints throughout, 'Requests' wrapping mid-word as 'Requ/ests' in the Usage 390 legend chip, Auth Files Updated values wrapping to 3 lines with an orphaned dash, and truncated labels ('OpenAI Compa...', 'Management Center I...').
metric_evidence.cleanliness: Observed. Restrained surfaces and generous whitespace keep dense pages calm. Detractors are duplicated content (System '3 available models' as both text and pill, alias helper text repeated twice, duplicate Refresh buttons on Plugins/Plugin Store), stacked beige banners on Plugin Store, and large empty chart cards on Usage.
metric_evidence.visual_design: Observed. Practical neutral identity with black primaries reads as a credible ops console, and dark mode is consistently executed on Dashboard/Providers/Quota/Config. Third-party promo elements (APIKEY.FUN card on Quick Start, BestProxy.com badge inside Config) and beige warning fills sit outside the neutral system and lower perceived professionalism versus mature developer dashboards.
metric_evidence.ease_of_use: Observed. Primary actions are findable on desktop list pages. Friction: on Providers 390 the selected provider's key table is buried below the full Configured/Not-configured list and is absent from the first viewport; Quick Start setup steps 1-4 show no navigation affordance; Save/Update appears fully active on Add-disablement while the body says 'Please enter a provider first'; top-bar actions are icon-only.
metric_evidence.information_hierarchy: Observed. H1, status line, then stat row order is consistent and scannable on Dashboard/Usage/Auth Files. Hierarchy failures: the APIKEY.FUN card precedes the actual Setup steps on Quick Start; on OAuth desktop descriptions sit in a distant right column detached from their buttons; near-empty charts receive the largest visual weight on Dashboard and Usage.
metric_evidence.spacing_alignment: Observed. Card padding, radius, and column alignment are mostly consistent, and Usage numeric columns are cleanly right-aligned. Failures: Providers table content collides and clips at 1440 in light and dark, the OAuth desktop two-column gap is excessive, Config toggle cards end in a 3-plus-1 orphan row, and filter/tab rows clip on Auth Files 390.
metric_evidence.navigation_wayfinding: Observed. Strongest area. Desktop sidebar groups (Operate/Gateway/Observe/Control), left-bar plus fill active state, count badge on Auth Files, and CPAMC/Page breadcrumbs make location unambiguous. Mobile keeps a labeled header but loses breadcrumbs, truncates 'Management Center I...', and sub-pages such as Add-disablement show only 'Auth Files' in the mobile header.
metric_evidence.responsive_mobile: Observed. No page-level horizontal overflow in the capture facts, and Config, Quota, Usage stats, and OAuth stack sensibly at 390. Material defects remain: Logs table and Auth Files tab/filter rows clip horizontally with no visible scroll cue, one Auth Files credential card fills the viewport with its toggle below the fold, and Providers detail is pushed far down the page. Mobile is adapted, not yet equally usable.
metric_evidence.accessibility_visible: Observed (visible scope only). Login shows a strong teal focus ring, fields have visible labels, status chips pair color with text, and most touch targets look at least roughly 40px. Visible risks: small low-contrast gray metadata/axis text in both themes, small amber warning text on Dashboard, icon-only top-bar and providers row actions, tiny count badges, and chart series distinguished mainly by small numbered color chips.
metric_evidence.data_visualization: Observed. Honest caveats, legends with values, timezone/bucket notes, and a 'View data table' disclosure are better than typical. Readability limits: the Dashboard request-flow chart is a near-flat zero line occupying a full card with tiny axis labels; in this fixture all four Quota series share 62% and overplot into one indistinguishable dashed line; Usage daily charts are empty placeholders; Auth Files mini bar strips with '--' have no visible scale or legend.
metric_evidence.interaction_affordance: Observed (visible affordance only). Filled black primaries, toggles, tabs, segmented controls, and search fields generally read as interactive. Weak affordances: Quick Start steps and OAuth 'Sign Up Now' read as plain text, provider chips on the alias/disablement forms have no visible selected state alongside a redundant provider input, 'Not reported' has a disclosure triangle for Claude/Codex rows but not Gemini rows, and System 'Copy' does not say what it copies.

top_fixes.screen: AI Providers 1440 light and dark (providers-1440.png, providers-dark-1440.png)
top_fixes.evidence: Status chips are cut mid-word ('Act', 'Succes', 'Failure:'), the Prefix pill 'workspace' overlaps the Models/Headers column, and row content is clipped at the card's right edge in both themes.
top_fixes.user_impact: Operators cannot read credential status or reliably hit row actions on a core management screen at standard desktop width.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Give the table a defined column budget that fits its container. Shorten or stack Status into compact labeled values, cap Prefix with ellipsis inside its own cell, and verify no cell crosses column boundaries at 1440 before release.

top_fixes.screen: Logs Viewer 390 and Auth Files 390 (logs-390.png, auth-files-390.png)
top_fixes.evidence: Logs columns and message text clip mid-word at the right edge ('Z INFO Management', header cut at 'L'). Auth Files clips the third tab ('OAuth Moc'), the provider filter row, and the filter placeholder under the search icon. No scroll fade, shadow, or other cue is visible.
top_fixes.user_impact: On mobile, log lines are unreadable and Auth Files destinations/filters appear missing rather than scrollable.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Convert Logs to a stacked mobile row (time, level/status, wrapped message) instead of a clipped table. Add an edge fade or visible scroll affordance to Auth Files tab/filter strips, and shorten the filter placeholder on small widths.

top_fixes.evidence: The first mobile viewport shows only the Configured/Not-configured provider list. The selected Gemini key table that sits beside the list on desktop is not visible and must be reached by scrolling past the long unconfigured list.
top_fixes.user_impact: The main mobile task, inspecting or editing the selected provider's keys, is buried under low-value zero-count entries.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: On mobile, render the selected provider's detail directly under the Configured group or make Not configured a collapsed disclosure. Keep the selected detail within the first scroll region.

top_fixes.evidence: An APIKEY.FUN card with New/Register now appears above Setup steps, and a 'No suitable proxy? BestProxy.com' badge sits inside the Config form under Proxy URL in all themes. Setup steps 1-4 are plain text rows with no visible link or button affordance.
top_fixes.user_impact: Third-party promotion outranks the onboarding task and erodes trust in a credential-handling console. New users read the steps but get no visible path to act on them.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Remove or clearly demote/label third-party promotions below task content. Make each setup step a labeled row action that deep-links to AI Providers, OAuth Login, Config Panel, and Usage Statistics, with completion state where detectable.

top_fixes.evidence: Request flow shows Success 0 / Failure 0 chips above a flat zero line filling a tall card, with small gray axis labels. In the Quota fixture, four series all at 62% overplot into a single dashed line distinguishable only by tiny numbered legend chips. This identical-values state may be fixture-driven, but the overplot handling is what is visible.
top_fixes.user_impact: At a glance, users cannot tell accounts apart on Quota, and the Dashboard devotes its largest element to a chart conveying almost no information.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Add end-of-line or legend-linked series emphasis and a visible treatment for exactly overlapping series (for example a combined-series note). Reduce empty/zero-state chart height, enlarge axis labels, and keep the existing data-table disclosure.

top_fixes.evidence: Each provider's name and login button occupy a left column while its description sits far right across a wide empty gap. 'Sign Up Now' is plain gray text next to filled black buttons. Button wording alternates between 'Log in', 'Log in to', and 'Start X Login' for equivalent actions.
top_fixes.user_impact: Eye travel between action and explanation is long, the secondary signup path is easy to miss, and inconsistent verbs slow scanning of an 8-plus provider list.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Use one row layout: icon and name, one-line description directly beneath, actions grouped at the row end. Standardize the primary verb, and render Sign Up Now as a consistent secondary button or clearly styled link. Consider search/filter once the list exceeds one screen.

top_fixes.screen: Cross-screen: Dashboard, Usage, Config, Quota, Plugins (desktop and mobile)
top_fixes.evidence: The same refresh concept appears as an outlined Refresh button, plain Refresh text, Reload text, an icon-only button, and 'Refresh all credentials'. Plugins and Plugin Store show two Refresh buttons on one screen (toolbar plus empty state). Top-bar refresh/language/theme/logout are icon-only everywhere.
top_fixes.user_impact: Equivalent actions look unrelated, duplicate actions create doubt about scope, and icon-only global controls depend on guessing or tooltips that screenshots cannot confirm.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Adopt one labeled refresh pattern with scope in the label where it differs, keep a single refresh per view, and add visible labels or text-accompanied controls for language, theme, and logout at least on desktop.

top_fixes.screen: Add provider model disablement / aliases 1440/390 (oauth-excluded, oauth-model-alias)
top_fixes.evidence: Save/Update renders as an enabled black primary while the disablement body states 'Please enter a provider first'. A provider text input and a set of provider chips are both presented with no visible selected state. The alias page repeats 'Defaults to the current filter...' verbatim in two places, including under Model aliases where it describes the wrong field.
top_fixes.user_impact: Users can attempt to save an incomplete form, cannot tell which provider selection method is authoritative, and read duplicated guidance that does not match the section.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Disable Save/Update visibly until required selections exist, with the blocking reason adjacent. Make chips show a selected state synced with the input, and remove or rewrite the duplicated helper text per section.

top_fixes.screen: Auth Files 1440, Usage Statistics 390, Management Center Info 1440
top_fixes.evidence: Auth Files Updated values wrap over 3 lines with an orphaned dash, and the Requests mini bar strip ends in an unexplained '--'. Usage 390 wraps 'Requests' mid-word in its legend chip. System shows '3 available models' as text and again as a pill, with '1 available models' grammar in groups.
top_fixes.user_impact: Small defects accumulate into an unfinished impression and leave data marks unexplained on otherwise polished pages.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Widen or reformat the Updated column (single-line date, time beneath), label or tooltip the request strip and its empty value, prevent mid-word legend wrapping, and de-duplicate/fix the model-count copy.

strengths: Consistent desktop shell: grouped sidebar, unambiguous active state, breadcrumbs, and uniform card/button language across 14 pages.
Dark mode holds together on all four captured screens, including charts, toggles, and warning text, without obvious surface or border breakage.

Data honesty is unusually good: fixture-independent caveats about snapshot vs live data, non-backfilled usage, dashed quota projections, and credentials no longer listed are stated next to the numbers.
Sensible empty states with a next action on Quick Start, Plugins, Plugin Store, and Config API keys, plus a prominent third-party plugin trust warning on Plugin Store.
Login is clean at both widths, with a clearly visible focus ring and an explicit warning that remembered keys use reversible obfuscation.
Mobile adaptation is real, not squeezed desktop, on Config (section select), Quota, Usage stats, OAuth, and System, with no page-level horizontal overflow in the capture facts.
unverified: All interaction behavior: hover, focus order, keyboard operation (including the chart arrow-key hint), menus, modals, toasts, form validation, save flows, OAuth flows, upload, and destructive confirmations were not exercised; affordance was judged from static screenshots only.

Screen-reader semantics, accessible names for icon-only controls, live regions, and measured contrast ratios were not verified; accessibility_visible covers only visible contrast, labels, and target sizing.
Content below the viewport on every screen, since captures are viewport-only, including the rest of Dashboard quota detail, Auth Files actions on mobile, and lower Config sections.
Loading, error, offline, unauthorized, and long-content states; behavior with production-scale data volumes, long names, and non-English locales.
Whether horizontally clipped mobile regions (Logs, Auth Files tabs/filters) are scrollable in practice; screenshots show clipping without a visible scroll cue.
Quota and plugin rendering with complete production data; fixture coverage is partial per evidence.json, so empty or identical-value states were not treated as proven production defects.
Motion and reduced-motion behavior in real use, and performance or responsiveness under load.

metric_evidence.design_coherence: The shell, sidebar, breadcrumb bar and card borders are consistent across all 14 pages. Refresh appears in five styles: outlined with icon (dashboard, providers), grey fill with no icon (usage, system), borderless ghost 'Reload' (config), icon-only (quota-390), and icon with no gap (auth-files). Filters use four patterns: underline tabs, provider tabs, a pill segmented control (auth-files), and bordered count chips (plugin-store). The page container shifts. Content starts at x=283 with the H1 at y=94 on dashboard, auth-files, quota and logs, but at x=315 with the H1 at y=126 on quick-start, providers and the oauth-excluded and alias pages.
metric_evidence.typography: H1 weight and the sans/mono split are clear. Mono is overused for prose, for example 'Use arrow keys to inspect points…' under both charts and 'Updated just now' metadata. Label colons are inconsistent ('Management Key:' vs 'Current URL', 'Connection Status:' vs 'Build Time'). Grammar defect in system-1440: '1 available models'. On mobile, 'Requests' breaks to 'Requ/ests' in the usage-390 legend chip, and quota legend filenames wrap mid-hyphen over 3 lines.
metric_evidence.cleanliness: There is generous whitespace and little decoration. Redundancy observed: plugins and plugin-store show two Refresh buttons each (toolbar plus empty state); system shows '3 available models' as text and again as a pill; the alias page repeats 'Defaults to the current filter…' in both steps. Developer-facing copy leaks into the UI: 'Each entry represents an API key (consistent with 'API Key Management' page style)'. A blurred shadow smudge sits at the top-left of every authenticated screenshot.
metric_evidence.visual_design: The neutral and teal palette is restrained and professional. Dark mode (dashboard, providers, quota, config) is coherent, with readable cards and inverted primary buttons. Provider brand icons add useful recognition. Two accents compete for the primary role, black-filled primary buttons and the teal active and link color, so 'primary' has no single color. The BestProxy.com promo chip inside the config form looks like an ad in a settings surface (preference-adjacent).
metric_evidence.ease_of_use: Core destinations are one click from the sidebar. Providers-1440 hides credential status because the Status chips are clipped ('Acti', 'Succes', 'Failure:'). Auth Files stacks three filter layers (section tabs, provider tabs, status pills) plus a sort select and Display options before any data. Warnings such as 'plugins.enabled is false' name a raw config key without a link to fix it. Logs show parsed column headers (Status, Method, Path) over rows that leave those columns empty.
metric_evidence.information_hierarchy: The dashboard KPI strip reads well at a glance. Its Requests card pairs a large '0' with a 4-line amber caveat ('Usage statistics recorded 132…'), so the headline number and the note disagree visually. This is fixture state, but the layout lets a caveat outweigh the metric. OAuth Login gives 9+ black primary buttons equal weight with no grouping. On usage-1440 the Top Models description is right-aligned and floats away from its title.
metric_evidence.spacing_alignment: Confirmed at 2x zoom. On providers-1440 the 'workspace' prefix chip overlaps the 'Models 1' text, and the Actions column covers the Status chips. Auth-files Refresh and Upload File icons touch their labels with no gap and sit above the text baseline; '+Add alias' shows the same defect. Step badges '01' and '02' sit at different x offsets (about 340 vs 332) on oauth-excluded. The quota y-axis '0%' collides with the 'Nov 6, 07:46 PM' x-axis label.
metric_evidence.navigation_wayfinding: The sidebar has meaningful group labels (Operate, Gateway, Observe, Control), a clear active state, a count badge on Auth Files, and breadcrumbs. Gaps: sub-pages keep the breadcrumb 'CPAMC / Auth Files' while the H1 reads 'Add provider model disablement'; H1s differ from nav labels ('Auth Files Management' vs 'Auth Files'); on auth-files-390 the third section tab is truncated to 'OAuth Mod' with no overflow cue; the header back chevron has no visible destination label.
metric_evidence.responsive_mobile: Evidence records no page-level overflow, and cards stack sensibly on dashboard, quick-start, oauth and plugins. Inside the page, logs-390 clips the table at the right edge ('Z INFO Management'); whether it scrolls is unverified. A single auth-files-390 credential card is taller than the viewport. The auth-files filter placeholder is clipped and its search icon overlaps the text. The logs toolbar wraps into 5 ragged rows. Config-390 switches to a native select that does not match the custom selects. OAuth-390 places the login button beside the title for Muse and Codex but below it for the Kimi providers.
metric_evidence.accessibility_visible: Login shows a strong visible focus ring on the key field. Fields have persistent labels, and text contrast is generally good in both themes. The charts show keyboard instructions and a 'View data table' fallback. Weak spots: the delete icon on the alias row is very light grey; amber caveat text on white (dashboard) may be borderline (contrast not measured); 11px uppercase sidebar group labels are small; mobile header icon glyphs are about 20px (hit area not measurable from screenshots); and the alias input placeholders repeat their labels, so the fields look filled.
metric_evidence.data_visualization: Strengths: numbered legend entries that carry current values, labeled axes, gridlines, a reset annotation, a keyboard hint and a data-table fallback. Observed defects that do not depend on the fixtures: series-index labels overprint each other where points coincide (illegible '1/2' glyph at dashboard 19:40, stacked '1234' blob at quota 75%); the 0% tick collides with the x-axis date; usage legend chips render 'Requests Not reported' above an empty-state message, and the chip wraps on mobile. Whether the quota chart separates actual from projected segments cannot be judged because all four identical series overlap (fixture), so it is unverified.
metric_evidence.interaction_affordance: Buttons, toggles and segmented controls read clearly as controls. Weak spots: auth-files 'Actions' is a blue disclosure triangle link, not a menu button; its Quota column mixes a bold '▶ Not reported' disclosure (Claude and Codex rows) with plain grey 'Not reported' (Gemini rows); the logs 'Auto Refresh' toggle sits between buttons and is easy to misread as a button; and 'Save/Update' on the oauth-excluded page looks fully enabled before any provider is chosen (actual disabled state unverified).

top_fixes.evidence: The sticky Actions column (toggle, eye, edit, delete) overlays the Status cell, clipping chips to 'Acti', 'Succes', 'Failure:'. The prefix chip 'workspace' overlaps 'Models 1'. Meanwhile about 40% of the content width sits empty to the right of the provider list.
top_fixes.user_impact: An operator cannot read credential health or failure counts on the main provider screen.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Give Status a min width (or stack its chips vertically), give the Actions column a solid background with a left divider so it never overlays, and set the Prefix column width from chip content. Alternatively, at widths below about 1100px of table space, collapse Models/Headers into one cell.

top_fixes.evidence: Series-index labels at coincident points overprint into illegible glyphs (dashboard '1' over '2' at 19:40; quota '1234' stack near 75%). The quota 0% tick collides with the first x-axis date.
top_fixes.user_impact: The chart's key annotation is unreadable exactly when series converge, which is common for quota resets and quiet periods.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Collision-avoid point labels: when markers coincide, render one combined label ('1–4' or '4 series') or offset labels vertically, or drop on-point labels and rely on the legend plus tooltip. Inset the x-axis labels or the 0% tick so they do not share a baseline.

top_fixes.evidence: Headers Time/Level/Status/Latency/Method/Path/Client/Source sit over rows where only Time and Level fill columns. The message wraps to a second line starting 'Z INFO' (stray timezone 'Z' and a duplicated level). Latency '842ms' floats unaligned. On mobile the table clips at the right edge, and the toolbar wraps into 5 ragged rows.
top_fixes.user_impact: Scanning and filtering logs, a core ops task, is harder than reading raw text.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Hide parsed columns that are empty for the visible rows (or fall back to Time | Level | Message), keep the full ISO timestamp intact, and remove the duplicated level from the message. On mobile, put search on the first row, then one overflow menu for Download, Clear and Full screen, with toggles in a compact settings popover. The parser-vs-fixture cause is unverified.

top_fixes.evidence: Refresh renders in 5 styles across dashboard, usage, config, quota-390 and auth-files. Filters use 4 visual patterns. The page container offset alternates between x=283/y=94 and x=315/y=126 depending on the page.
top_fixes.user_impact: Users relearn equivalent controls per page, and page switches visibly jump, which undermines trust in the console's polish.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Define one PageHeader (title, meta line, actions slot) and one page container width/padding, and use them on every route. Standardize Refresh as an outlined button with icon and an 8px gap, icon-only only below 360px. Keep two filter patterns: underline tabs for sections and a segmented control for status.

top_fixes.evidence: Three stacked filter layers, a filter placeholder truncated under its search icon ('Use * as⊗'), Refresh and Upload icons touching their labels, mixed Quota cell styles, and an 'Actions' disclosure link. On mobile one credential card is taller than the 844px viewport and the third tab is clipped to 'OAuth Mod'.
top_fixes.user_impact: Comparing several credentials on a phone takes repeated scrolling, and finding the bulk or row actions takes guesswork.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Merge provider tabs into the filter row as a select or chips, shorten the placeholder to 'Filter credentials' with pattern help in a tooltip, and add a gap token to icon buttons. Use a kebab menu button for row actions. On mobile, use a 3-line compact row (identity + provider badge, status + toggle, requests sparkline) with details on tap, and add a scroll fade or overflow menu to the section tabs.

top_fixes.evidence: A blurred grey smudge sits at the top-left above 'CPAMC' and the mobile hamburger. Inferred cause: `.skip-link` keeps `box-shadow: 0 8px 24px` while translated off-screen (src/styles/layout.scss:1024-1038).
top_fixes.user_impact: A permanent rendering artifact in the most-viewed corner reads as a glitch.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Apply the shadow only in :focus/:focus-visible, or hide the unfocused link with visibility or clip, so it casts nothing at rest.

top_fixes.evidence: The usage legend chip breaks 'Requ/ests'. Quota legend filenames wrap over 3 lines inside 2-column chips. Config uses a native select unlike the other selects. OAuth button placement alternates between title-adjacent and below the title.
top_fixes.user_impact: Mobile pages look assembled per component rather than designed for the width, which slows scanning.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Make legend chips single-column on narrow widths with ellipsized filenames and full names in a tooltip. Set min-width: max-content on chip labels. Use the shared Select on config. Always place the OAuth CTA below the title at 390px.

top_fixes.evidence: Copy defects: 'consistent with 'API Key Management' page style', '1 available models', label colons applied inconsistently, raw 'plugins.enabled is false' with no fix action, duplicate '3 available models', 'Save/Update' slash label, and a 4-line caveat under the dashboard Requests KPI.
top_fixes.user_impact: Small but compounding signs of an unfinished product. The raw config key forces users to locate the setting themselves.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Remove dev notes, pluralize correctly, drop trailing colons on labels, and add an 'Open in Config' link to the plugin warning. Use one verb ('Save'). Shorten the KPI caveat to one line with an info tooltip.

strengths: Sidebar IA is meaningful (Operate/Gateway/Observe/Control) with a clear active state and a useful Auth Files count badge.
Neutral/teal identity is restrained and professional. Dark mode is coherent across the four captured pages.
Charts include keyboard instructions, a data-table fallback, value-bearing numbered legends and a reset annotation, which shows accessibility intent beyond most dashboards.
Usage Statistics KPI strip and Top Models table are well aligned, use right-aligned numerics, and highlight failures in red.
Honest data provenance copy ('Reported snapshots, not live usage', 'not backfilled') suits an ops tool, though it is wordy.
Config Panel's visual/source toggle, sectioned sub-nav and searchable settings is a strong pattern for a 61-setting surface.
Plugin Store's trust warning is prominent and specific about risk.
